scope: Visual acceptance only: every actual revised Old English glossary page inspected at native full-page resolution. This does not certify source evidence, lexical coverage, master-to-TeX parity or complete ordered PDF text parity; the coordinator checks those independently.

method.viewing_scope: Every complete page, including headings, both text columns where present, special letters/length marks, line endings, margins, running headers and folios. No contact-sheet-only substitutions.
method.identity_checks: Current PDF hash equals the raster manifest; all 58 actual image hashes verified from bytes after viewing.
method.content_claim_limit: Readable glyph shape and layout were inspected; a hash match is not treated as content parity or linguistic verification.
method.diagnostic_check: Current final and second-pass logs read for errors, missing glyphs, box warnings and LaTeX/package warnings.
